meta.title: All line items start in Lot 1; maximum of 4 lots

plan.title: RFQ lot defaults and four-lot limit

steps.note: Open an existing event in the required evaluation state.
Navigate to the RFQ stage where lot splitting is available.

args.goal: Open Settings, choose Split Line Items into Lots, verify that all five line items are initially assigned to Lot 1, then open the lot dropdown beside a line item serial number and verify that it offers Lot 1, Lot 2, Lot 3 and Lot 4 but no lot beyond Lot 4; stop with the dropdown evidence visible.

steps.note: Perform and verify the lot assignment and maximum-lot checks directly on the buyer's screen.
Assert the resulting screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers or invalid values.
